item.title: Russian strike on Kyiv region kills 4 and wounds 15, with peace talks stalled
item.summary: The strikes comes after the United States paused ceasefire talks between Russia and Ukraine due to the war with Iran.

item.title: U.S. Embassy in Baghdad again urges Americans to leave Iraq as Trump touts strikes on Iran
item.summary: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump claimed the U.S. had "destroyed 100% of Iran's Military capability." The U.S. Embassy in Baghdad, meanwhile, urged Americans to "leave Iraq immediately."

item.title: 'War of the Worlds' remake sinks to the bottom at this year's Razzie Awards
item.summary: The surveillance industry version of HG Wells' 1898 classic sci-fi novel stars Ice Cube, and won accolades for worst picture, actor, director and more.

item.title: With boom in prediction markets, some lawmakers worry about how to police themselves
item.summary: House and Senate ethics committees give no financial disclosure guidance on event contracts or prediction markets — unlike stock, cryptocurrency and bond trades.

item.title: Brazil's ex-President Bolsonaro is in intensive care with pneumonia, hospital says
item.summary: One of Bolsonaro's doctors described the former Brazilian president's medical condition as "serious."

item.title: Why women have an especially tough time in Senegal's prisons
item.summary: Women charged with a crime in Senegal are at the mercy of a slow judicial process and prisons that may lack basic supplies. They also face stigma that robs them of familial and community support.

item.title: The Oscars are Sunday night. Here's how to watch
item.summary: The Oscars start at 7 p.m. Eastern, 4 p.m. Pacific on Sunday, airing on ABC and streaming on Hulu.

item.title: Reframing Georgia O'Keeffe's legacy and protecting the land she loved
item.summary: Georgia O'Keeffe called the New Mexico high desert "my country," but Pueblo peoples predated her. A more complex view is emerging amid efforts to preserve the land.

item.title: In South Carolina, measles shows how far apart neighbors can be on vaccines
item.summary: In South Carolina, some parents embrace vaccines, others opt out. Why do people make such different choices? A mix of politics, distrust and misinformation is pushing neighbors apart.

item.title: Opinion: An ancient, sophisticated palate
item.summary: Researchers looking at foodcrusts on the pottery shards of ancient humans say there's evidence of a wide variety of ingredients, indicating that they may have been experimenting with "recipes."
